Container.Name: Tofarr
Container.Overview:
Tofarr is an unofficial companion app for the Tofa media server. It builds Tofa collections from TMDB, Trakt and IMDb lists, Tofa's own discovery shelves or a list of TMDB ids, keeps them in the order of the source, and updates them on a schedule. A Discover page shows posters with an In library badge, and with Seerr connected you can request titles you do not have. Nothing is written until you have seen a preview.
Setup: open the web UI and create your login, then open Settings and enter your Tofa address (for example http://192.168.1.10:33333, not the relay) and an admin API key from Tofa under Server, Settings, API keys. A free TMDB API key is needed for TMDB and IMDb sources, a Trakt client ID for Trakt, and a Seerr address and key for requests. The variables below are optional defaults for the same settings.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI. Only change the host side; the container always listens on 8080.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database (collection definitions and run history) is stored.

Config.Name: TOFA_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Can also be set in the web UI. Direct address of your Tofa server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:33333 (API keys do not work through the relay).

Config.Name: TOFA_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Can also be set in the web UI. Admin API key from Tofa Server > Settings > API keys (shown once when created).

Config.Name: TMDB_API_KEY
Config.Description: Free API key from themoviedb.org/settings/api. Needed for TMDB collection, list and discover sources.

Config.Name: TRAKT_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Client ID of a Trakt app (trakt.tv/oauth/applications). Needed for Trakt list sources.

Config.Name: SEERR_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Address of your Seerr, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5055. Lets you request titles you do not have.

Config.Name: SEERR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Seerr API key (Seerr, Settings, General).

Config.Name: AUTH_RESET
Config.Description: Forgot the password? Set this to true for one start. It removes the login so you can create a new one. Clear it again afterwards.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, used for run timestamps.
